props.name: items
props.description: The actions to fan out, each with a label, icon and optional onSelect.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the centre button in px.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Arc in degrees. 0 is right, -90 is up. Defaults to the upper half.

props.name: endAngle
props.description: Angle in degrees where the arc ends. 0 is right, -90 is up.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the centre button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
